pass.answer: Mitigation: start each run with a reconciliation pass. Read the receipt ids already in expenses.csv and the files already in done/, and process only PDFs that appear in neither.
Reconcile before acting: compare inbox/ against the CSV and the drive, then do only the missing steps for each receipt.

fail.answer: Mitigation: add a lock file so only one run happens at a time, and log every upload.
fail.why: a lock alone does not read existing state; no reconciliation step
